params.kv_budget_rule: peak_active_bytes + headroom x reusable working set (both measured under evict-now at the calibrated rate)
params.load_reference: arrival rate calibrated to util under keep-all at the full-headroom budget (active + WS, from a pass-1 rate at kv_mb_at_1x * max(1, scale // 2)); every headroom at a scale runs at that rate

calibrations.name: arrival_rate[1x]
calibrations.target: GPU busy fraction 0.8 under FCFS/keep-all at the full-headroom budget (active + WS from pass 1)

calibrations.name: reusable_working_set_bytes[1x]
calibrations.target: max over seeds of peak live reusable bytes, measured under evict-now; achieved = peak active bytes
